handoff_payload.answer_text: Operating margin is not a particularly useful metric for AMEX, a financial-services company, because interest income, funding costs, and credit-loss provisions are core operating items. Using pretax margin as a more relevant proxy, AMEX was not improving as of 2022: it declined to 16.5% from 25.2% in 2021, although total expenses fell to 70.6% of revenue from 78.1%.
